segments.subtask: The person is holding a pencil and preparing to draw on the paper.

The person draws a sun with rays around the circle.
The person draws a cloud above the sun.
The person draws a wave pattern below the sun.
The person draws a tree on the right side of the paper.
The person draws another tree on the left side of the paper.
The person draws a mountain in the background.
The person draws a path leading to the sun.
The person draws a beach scene with sand and water.
The person draws a boat on the water.
The person draws a fish in the water.
The person draws a bird flying in the sky.
The person draws a flower near the tree.
The person draws a fence around the beach area.
The person finishes the drawing and lifts the pencil.
